name: Deadly Spinning Blade Pillar

stealth.details: (master) or DC 48 (master) to find the control panel

disable: DC 39 Thievery check (master) three times on a pillar, or DC 37 Thievery check (master) twice on the control panel deactivates the whole trap. Breaking the control panel prevents anyone from disabling the trap using the control panel and prevents the trap from deactivating automatically (see Reset below)
reset: The trap deactivates and resets after 1 minute.
routine: (3 actions) The trap uses its first action to make a spinning blade Strike against each adjacent creature. Its second action is to move in a random direction (roll 1d4 to determine the direction), and its third action to make a spinning blade Strike against each adjacent creature.

items.name: Descending Pillar
items.text:
Trigger A creature steps on one of the marked trigger plates

---
Effect The pillar descends from the ceiling at the marked grid intersection and makes a spinning blade Strike against one adjacent creature (if any). The trap then rolls initiative.

text: A spinning metal pole covered in deadly blades is hidden in the ceiling, connected to several trigger plates around the room and a hidden control panel built into the bed frame.
